init.title: PANDA ESL Options
init.description: Adjust how rendered service images are written to the device.

data_description.retry_count: Number of times to retry a rendered service write before giving up.
data_description.write_delay_ms: Delay between PANDA packets. The default keeps the known-good diagnostic write timing.
data_description.prevent_duplicate_send: Skip guarded writes when the new image is identical to the last rendered image.
data_description.debounce_ms: Delay before writing to the device. New guarded writes cancel pending ones. 0 = disabled.
